evidence.summary: Reviewed all 72 existing listening-prediction fronts across six CET4/CET6 boxes, against original front wording and unchanged reference answers. Removed authoring-style preambles and repetitive UI instructions; every clue and the prediction-before-listening step remain. Checked topic, question focus and logical-signal meaning, and corrected drafts that narrowed library interest to attendance or activity conditions to participant eligibility. Only three mirrored front text fields changed. Answers, analyses, synthetic provenance, audio transcripts and audio references are byte-semantically unchanged. The audit retains 72 short-analysis signals and 72 explicit synthetic-source signals; this is scoped language acceptance, not full-track or audio authorization.

scope.purpose: reader-facing listening-prediction wording in CET4 and CET6
